about: Get a 60-day multiple-entry visa if you live in Oman and often visit UAE border areas.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Multiple-entry visa for Oman residents visiting border areas. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For residents of the Sultanate of Oman who often visit neighbouring UAE border areas
Passport valid for at least 6 months
Valid 60 days before entry; stay up to 60 days from entry
documents: To-whom-it-may-concern certificate from the Omani authorities
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
